description.value: Armstrong Regional Co-op is a community-owned cooperative with roots going back to 1922, operating gas bars with attached convenience stores across the North Okanagan region of BC. This Vernon-area location is part of a network offering fuel, convenience items, and liquor under the Co-op brand. Touring cyclists passing through can expect a roadside stop with fuel and convenience store goods typical of a Co-op gas bar.
